name: local-capability-v1
notes: 36 items, eight categories, every score programmatic - no judge model, no human. Items are written for this repository rather than taken from a published benchmark, so contamination is unlikely and the answer key is auditable in this file. ANSWER: extraction means a model that reasons correctly but writes prose still scores; code items are graded by executing unit tests, not by matching text. Budgets are identical for every model, and deliberately generous for the categories where a thinking model spends tokens before it starts answering.
suffix:
Think as much as you need. Finish with a final line of exactly this form:
ANSWER: <your answer>
